critique: Exceptional execution across all criteria. The vertical rectangular monolith housing in deep navy matte finish is spot-on. The upper dial features exactly the 9 required radial tick marks with a completely blank bottom arc, and all 5 beach labels are spelled and positioned accurately. The lower sub-dial and single burnt-orange hands on each dial match the reference precisely. The surfboard shaper's workshop setting with golden hour sunbeams, dust motes, wood planer, and foam/wood curls provides rich, authentic cinema-grade art direction.
